settings.title: 77-Day "Comfiest Clothes" Guarantee
settings.text: Buying clothes online is hard. We make it easy. You've got a 77-day guarantee on your first pair of Jambys. You can wear 'em risk-free for 11 whole Sundays. And if you don't love 'em by then, we'll process your return and pay for the shipping, too. (Spoiler: doesn't happen very often!)
